about.es: Duke Nukem 3D con el motor Build, por Chocolate Duke3D. Se juega acostado.
about.en: Duke Nukem 3D on the Build engine, through Chocolate Duke3D. Played lying down.

user_files.es: Los datos del juego no vienen con la app: copiá tu DUKE3D.GRP (el shareware 1.3D sirve) a la carpeta duke3d/ de la tarjeta.
user_files.en: The game's data does not come with the app: copy your DUKE3D.GRP (the 1.3D shareware will do) to the card's duke3d/ folder.
